audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gangplank levels 2 and 3 while the whys beside those rows said the opposite ('Your W-root into Q-knockback combo lands before his barrel chain is online', 'You still win the short trade'). It also gave him 2+ items outright and left level 6 as Skill, which is backwards from the packet chart.
audit.why: Levels 2-3 are the one window where Maokai has a combo and Gangplank has neither a stocked keg line nor a levelled Remove Scurvy. Level 6 is where Cannon Barrage and the item spike arrive, and full build is decided by format rather than by either player.
audit.corrected: Chart brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group: Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill, with ratings adjusted to match. The mirror audit aligned its side to the same packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described only as 'Nature's Grasp roots whole teams' with no mention of what Gangplank gains at 6.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s, global, and deals true damage — resistances, which are Maokai's entire scaling plan, do nothing against it.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why alongside the Maokai-side R note.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page tracks 'Powder Kegs' as the punishable cooldown. Powder Keg has no cooldown in the kit data (cd 0, cost 0) — it is a stored-charge ability. The genuinely punishable cooldown is Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14s, and it cleanses Maokai's W root and R root outright.
audit.why: Telling the player to wait out a charge-based ability produces a lane where he never commits; telling him to bait a 22-second cleanse gives him an actual window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten to name Remove Scurvy as the matchup-defining cooldown and to say the kegs are charges to be popped, not waited out. The 22s figure also written into tradeGood and phases[2].why.
sources: enemyKit W: cd 22/20/18/16/14, cures crowd control

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Sap Magic's cooldown drops when an enemy SPELL strikes Maokai.
audit.why: Gangplank's whole early game is Parrrley poke, and every Parrrley that lands accelerates Maokai's heal — it reframes level 1 from 'survive the poke' to 'his poke funds my sustain'.
sources: ownerKit P text: 'Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced'

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy: matchup-defining — it cleanses your root and heals, 22s at rank 1. Commit only after he eats it. - Powder Kegs are stored charges, not one cooldown: pop them, never wait them out.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Sap Magic heals your autos and speeds up each time his Parrrley hits you — level 1 you out-sustain one keg, so deny his last hits.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: W-root into Q-knockback lands before Remove Scurvy exists, and he cannot cleanse what he has not levelled.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy comes online on 22s and cleanses your root outright — bait it, or trade only after he eats it. That is the check.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage is global true damage on 160s — resistances do not help, so walk out of the zone rather than tank it. Your R is gank setup.

edits.before: W-root Gangplank the moment his answer is down, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax his every path.
edits.after: W-root him once Remove Scurvy is spent — 22s at rank 1 — then Q-knock him off the keg and let brush saplings tax his path.

edits.before: At Level 1 he can only barrel-poke and you out-sustain a single keg — deny his last hits and don't trade into a fresh barrel.
edits.after: Level 1 is mine: he has one keg and no cleanse, and Sap Magic speeds up whenever his Parrrley strikes me, so his poke funds my heal.

edits.before: Full-build Gangplank crits through your resistances and kites your W with passive move speed — survive as the engage tank and let your team punish him.
edits.after: Full build it turns on the format: he crits through my resistances 1v1, but in a 5v5 my R roots his whole side and he has one Remove Scurvy to spend.

notes: Two claims already on the page could not be verified from the kits and were left untouched: that Sapling Toss destroys or denies Powder Kegs (wants.you[1], mid), and that Gangplank's passive grants move speed to kite (whys[6] original, spikes[3]) — Riot's passive text is only 'sets his opponent on fire'. Both recorded as unverified. Powder Keg is listed with cd 0 and cost 0, i.e. charge-based; the page's repeated 'track Powder Kegs's cooldown' framing is structurally wrong but appears in focus.text, loading, dosFull and six report/breakdown strings, so I corrected the load-bearing one (breakdown.cooldowns) rather than cascade a rename through fields the mirror also touches.
